name: adidas Yeezy Slides 'Slate Grey'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Slide ‘Slate Grey’ presents a neutral colorway of the lightweight and durable slip-on silhouette. A medium grey finish is applied to the one-piece build, composed of injected EVA foam with a seamless wide-strap upper. Exterior branding is limited to adidas’ three-stripe logo debossed on the footbed, featuring a soft top layer for step-in comfort. Underfoot, deep grooves in the outsole provide superior traction and a comfortable ride.
